description: The parties of the UBL example world: their place on the map, what they do and their identity. referenced: parties that are only referred to in a document (identifier and name), with no place on the map and no documents of their own.

parties.name: Raw Material Supplier
parties.what: Mines the ore at the start of the chain and sells it to the manufacturer.
parties.how: A mine sells a few products in large volumes to a small number of customers. With UBL, its orders, despatch advices and invoices carry the same quantities, lot numbers and weights from the first document to the last, so the buyer can match them without retyping weighbridge tickets.

site.description: The mine and its rail siding
site.conditions: Unpaved access road; heavy vehicles only.

wiki.short: Urvanian iron ore mine on the flank of the massif
wiki.lead: **Serravona Mining** works an underground iron ore mine on the lower flank of the volcanic massif in the north-west of [[Urvania]], with its address at Fucinalta. It was founded in {founded_year} and employs about {employees} people.

sections.title: History
sections.text: The company was founded in 1958, under the British administration, as a joint company of the administration and Ferrano's iron merchants, to work the ore at Serravona. In 1963 the new state bought out the merchants, and the mine became one of the pillars of the protected economy, beside state energy and the country's own manufacturers. Urvania kept it when it opened its economy in the 1990s: the company is wholly owned by the state, which holds the ore as a national asset.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: The mine is entered by an adit in the hillside at about 720 m, 29 km from the mining village of Serravona. A small crushing and screening plant and a spoil heap stand beside it; the hillside around it stays green. The ore line is laid up to the portal, where the wagons are loaded and weighed at the mine's own siding, and runs about 166 km down to the works of [[Valdara Industries]] in [[Ferrano]].

sections.title: Trade
sections.text: The mine sells lump ore with about 62 % iron to Valdara under a yearly supply agreement: one train a month, free carrier at the mine siding, with a deduction for moisture. A train of 30 wagons carries about 1,790 t, hauled by [[Ferrano Rail Cargo]].

parties.name: Manufacturer
parties.what: Makes park benches and street furniture: frames of ductile iron made from the mine's ore and about 35 % steel and iron scrap and cast in its own foundry, slats from the sawmill in Bayvarra, packed in recycled packaging from Bayvarra. Sells to the distributor abroad and tenders in public procurement.
parties.how: The manufacturer sits in the middle of the chain: it buys, produces, sells, exports and tenders. UBL gives it one vocabulary for all of that, from the order it places with the mine to the certificate of origin and the tender it submits to a public buyer, so the same item, party and price data are reused instead of re-entered for every partner.

account_abroad.why: A lume account at Bank of Lumeport, which also gave Valdara's tender guarantee: the public works department pays the framework contract in its own currency into a domestic account, and Valdara converts later if it wants, its currency risk covered by its forward contract.

wiki.short: Urvanian maker of park benches and street furniture
wiki.lead: **Valdara Industries** is a maker of park benches and street furniture in [[Ferrano]], [[Urvania]], founded in {founded_year}, the year of Urvania's independence. It casts its frames in its own foundry and employs about {employees} people.

sections.title: History
sections.text: Valdara was founded in 1962 as one of the manufacturers of Urvania's protected economy. When the [[Lumeport Trade Accord]] entered into force in 1996, it made [[Lumeway Distribution]] its distributor for [[Bayvarra]] and [[Lisavu]], which is why its benches reach the island through [[Lumeport]].

sections.title: Products
sections.text: Its best-known product is the park bench Serra 180: frames of ductile iron, cast in its foundry from the mine's ore and about 35 % steel and iron scrap, with slats from the sawmill in [[Marrowdale]], packed in recycled packaging from [[Bayvarra]].

sections.title: Trade
sections.text: Valdara sells to its distributor abroad and tenders in public procurement; it buys ore from [[Serravona Mining]] and timber from [[Marrowdale Sawmill]].

parties.name: Seller's Warehouse (3PL)
parties.what: Picks, packs and hands the goods to the carrier for the manufacturer; knows nothing about prices.
parties.how: A third-party warehouse acts on instructions from its client but never sees the commercial terms. UBL separates the two: the warehouse sends despatch advices and inventory reports with exactly the logistic details (packages, weights, serial numbers) while prices stay in the documents between seller and buyer.

wiki.short: Urvanian warehouse and logistics company of Valdara Industries
wiki.lead: **Castrano Logistics** runs the finished-goods warehouse of [[Valdara Industries]] at Conciaro, near [[Ferrano]], [[Urvania]]. Founded in {founded_year} and wholly owned by Valdara, it picks, packs and loads the bench maker's goods for the carriers and employs about {employees} people.

sections.title: History
sections.text: Valdara set up Castrano in 1998, when its exports grew after the [[Lumeport Trade Accord]] came into force, and handed it its logistics. Castrano registered with the [[Codana Identification Agency]] in March 2000, among the agency's early members.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: The warehouse stands on Via del Magazzino at Conciaro, a village east of Ferrano on the main road to the border. Valdara owns the building; Castrano operates it every day from 06:00 to 22:00. It handles the goods but not their prices: it makes up the pallets, marks each with a licence plate of its own numbering, which ends in a check character, and hands them to the carrier the buyer or the seller has booked, among them [[Trasvia Haulage]] for the road across the border and [[Ferrano Rail Cargo]] for containers to the rail hub. It keeps one box truck of its own.

parties.name: Waste Processor
parties.what: Recovers polyethylene from the production waste of several factories, Valdara's among them: it collects the baled film, weighs each load on its weighbridge, reports it to the environment agency and invoices the net tonnes; it sells the granulate it makes, certified for its recycled content.
parties.how: Waste movements must be announced and tracked before the waste leaves the site. UBL's waste notification and waste movement documents describe the waste, its producer and the facility that recovers or disposes of it, and the same parties then appear on the invoice for the removal service.

wiki.short: Urvanian recycler of polyethylene production waste
wiki.lead: **Rinova Recovery** is a plastics recycler in [[Ferrano]], [[Urvania]], founded in {founded_year}. It recovers polyethylene from the production waste of several factories and turns it into granulate. It employs about {employees} people.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: Rinova collects baled polyethylene film and offcuts from factories, [[Valdara Industries]] among them, whose waste [[Trasvia Haulage]] brings across Ferrano by truck. Each load is weighed full and empty on Rinova's weighbridge, and the waste is charged by the net tonne. The plant holds a permit for the recovery of non-hazardous plastic waste from the [[Environment Agency of Urvania]] and reports each load it receives to the agency. Its granulate is certified for its recycled content by an accredited certification body in Ferrano, which audits the plant every year.

sections.title: Facilities and trade
sections.text: The plant stands on the river at Ferrano with a quay of its own. From it the granulate goes in jumbo bags of one tonne on the barges of [[Fiumella Barges]], about 250 km down the river and the estuary, to [[Rivermouth Packaging]] on [[Bayvarra]]'s coast, which makes stretch film and garment bags from it. Rinova is registered with the [[Codana Identification Agency]] and numbers its goods under its system.

parties.name: Rail Carrier
parties.what: Runs the ore trains from the mine to the factory and the container trains from the Ferrano hub to Lumeway's siding in Marrowdale, on train paths of the rail infrastructure manager; its tractor brings the containers to the hub.
parties.how: A rail carrier plans capacity on a fixed timetable. UBL transport documents let its customers request and confirm transport plans and receive status updates per train and wagon, with the same consignment references the forwarder and the receiving terminal use.

wiki.short: Urvanian rail freight company running ore and container trains
wiki.lead: **Ferrano Rail Cargo** is a rail freight company of [[Urvania]], with its depot at {town} in the Province of Ferrano. It was founded in {founded_year} and runs the ore trains from the mine to the bench works at [[Ferrano]] and the container trains across the border to [[Marrowdale]]. It employs about {employees} people.

sections.title: History
sections.text: The company was set up in 1964, two years after independence, as the freight arm of Urvania's state railway, to run the ore trains from the mine to the new bench works at Ferrano; its depot is still at Serravona, where its oldest trains start. In 2004 Urvania separated its rail infrastructure from its train operators: the tracks, the train paths and the traffic control went to the [[Rail Infrastructure Agency of Urvania]], and the company's managers and staff bought the freight business, with a loan from [[Crevalto Bank]]. It has run its trains on the paths the agency gives it since.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: Its ore trains carry the ore of [[Serravona Mining]] about 166 km down the ore line from the mine siding to the works of [[Valdara Industries]] in [[Ferrano]], priced per tonne. Its container trains run from the [[Ferrano Intermodal Hub]] across the border to the rail siding of [[Lumeway Distribution]] in [[Marrowdale]], under the Accord's uniform rules for international carriage by rail. For these it sells container slots under a framework contract with Valdara, payable 30 days net, and its own tractor brings the packed containers from the warehouse to the hub. A container gets five free days at the consignee's siding; after that the company charges demurrage per container day.

sections.title: Fleet
sections.text: The company runs the container train FRC 4417, the ore train FRC 2208 with its bulk ore wagons, and a road tractor for its container haulage to the hub.

parties.name: Road Carrier
parties.what: Trucks the goods across the land border, both ways: benches to Bayvarra, slats and film back to Urvania; registered with Urvania's environment agency as a waste carrier, it also takes Valdara's baled waste film to Rinova across Ferrano.
parties.how: Road carriers handle many short jobs with frequent changes. With UBL they receive transport instructions, report status at each stop and invoice the freight in one structured format, so every customer, large or small, can process them automatically.

authorization.purpose: Transport of non-hazardous waste by road
authorization.note: Shown where Trasvia carries waste; its road haulage licence XU-HAUL-2020-0877 (haulage-licence register, valid to 2030-06-30) covers its other carriage and is not shown in a document.

wiki.short: Urvanian road haulier for cross-border and local loads
wiki.lead: **Trasvia Haulage** is a road haulier in [[Ferrano]], [[Urvania]], founded in {founded_year}, when cross-border trucking opened under the [[Lumeport Trade Accord]]. It carries full truck loads across the land border with [[Bayvarra]] and within Urvania, and employs about {employees} people.

sections.title: History
sections.text: Trasvia was founded in January 1996, the month the Lumeport Trade Accord entered into force, as one of the hauliers set up to serve the new cross-border trade.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: Trasvia trucks benches and spare frames from Ferrano to [[Lumeway Distribution]] in [[Marrowdale]] and samples to [[Lumeport]] airport, and on the way back brings bench slats and stretch film to [[Valdara Industries]]. It holds an international road haulage licence and is registered with the [[Environment Agency of Urvania]] as a carrier of non-hazardous waste, which lets it take Valdara's baled waste film across Ferrano to [[Rinova Recovery]]. Its planning desk works every day from 06:00 to 22:00. It charges by the kilometre driven loaded, tolls included.

sections.title: Fleet
sections.text: Its tractor unit 07 pulls a 13.6 m curtain-side trailer for 33 pallets. Tractor and trailer weigh about 15.3 t empty, which leaves about 24.7 t of payload within the Accord's limit of 40 t.

parties.name: Inland Waterway Carrier
parties.what: Moves bulk on the river from Urvania down to the coast of Bayvarra.
parties.how: Inland waterway transport moves large volumes slowly. UBL transport execution plans and waybills carry the barge, the loading and discharge quays and the cargo per hold, so shippers and terminals can plan around long transit times.

wiki.short: Urvanian river barge operator at Ferrano
wiki.lead: **Fiumella Barges** carries bulk cargo by barge on the main river, from [[Ferrano]] in [[Urvania]] down to the coast of [[Bayvarra]]. It has worked the river since {founded_year} and employs about {employees} people.

sections.title: History
sections.text: Fiumella belongs to the old trades of Urvania that are older than its independence: Urvania has always sent bulk goods down the river to the sea.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: Its office and quay are on Banchina del Fiume in Ferrano. The barges work below the rapids above the town, which end navigation, and sail about 250 km down the river and the estuary towards [[Lumeport]] without locks. They sail by daylight only, and the receiver's morning shift unloads them. Fiumella carries, among other loads, the recycled plastic granulate of [[Rinova Recovery]] in one-tonne bags from Rinova's own quay to the river quay of [[Rivermouth Packaging]]; the freight of goods going abroad is free of Urvania's value added tax.

sections.title: Fleet
sections.text: Its dry-cargo barge Fiumella IV, of 1,210 gross tonnes, is registered at Ferrano.

parties.name: Rail Hub / Intermodal Terminal
parties.what: The intermodal terminal of Ferrano, on the container line that runs on past the border to Marrowdale: it takes the containers in by road, stacks them and lifts them onto the container trains, and reports to the rail carrier what it has loaded; the tracks and the train paths are the rail infrastructure manager's.
parties.how: An intermodal terminal is where rail and road meet. UBL status messages and transport reports let it tell carriers and forwarders when a container arrived, was transferred or left, using the same equipment and consignment identifiers on both sides of the transfer.

wiki.short: Intermodal rail terminal at Ferrano, Urvania
wiki.lead: **Ferrano Intermodal Hub** is the intermodal terminal of [[Ferrano]], [[Urvania]], on the container line that runs on across the border to [[Marrowdale]]. It was founded in {founded_year} and employs about {employees} people.

sections.title: History
sections.text: The hub was built as a border terminal for the traffic of the [[Lumeport Trade Accord]], which entered into force in 1996, one of the companies set up in the Accord's first years to serve the new cross-border trade.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: The terminal stands in Ferrano's industrial zone along the railway east of the centre. It takes containers in by road, stacks them and lifts them onto the container trains of [[Ferrano Rail Cargo]], to which it reports what it has loaded. The tracks and the train paths belong to the [[Rail Infrastructure Agency of Urvania]], since Urvania separated its rail infrastructure from its train operators. Among the goods that pass through it are the park benches of [[Valdara Industries]] for [[Lumeway Distribution]], brought in containers from the warehouse of [[Castrano Logistics]]. The terminal works around the clock.

parties.name: Bank (XU)
parties.what: A bank in Ferrano: holds the accounts of the mine, the manufacturer, the carriers and the energy companies of Urvania, and receives their payments from home and abroad.
parties.how: The seller's bank receives payments from many countries. Because UBL invoices carry the payee account and a payment reference, and remittance advices repeat that reference, incoming payments can be matched to the right invoices automatically.

wiki.short: Bank in Ferrano, Urvania
wiki.lead: **Crevalto Bank** is a bank in [[Ferrano]], [[Urvania]], founded in {founded_year}, before the country's independence. It is listed on the Ferrano Stock Exchange and employs about {employees} people.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: Crevalto Bank holds the accounts of most of Urvania's trading companies around Ferrano: [[Serravona Mining]], [[Valdara Industries]], [[Castrano Logistics]], [[Rinova Recovery]], the carriers [[Ferrano Rail Cargo]], [[Trasvia Haulage]] and [[Fiumella Barges]], the energy companies [[Ferrano Energy]], [[Montebrio Power]] and [[Ferrano Grid]], and [[Tostara Wood Modification]]. It receives their payments from home and abroad. When Valdara tendered for park benches in [[Lumeport]], Crevalto gave the counter-guarantee on which [[Bank of Lumeport]] issued Valdara's tender guarantee.

sections.title: Branches
sections.text: Its head office and main branch are in the Palazzo Crevalto on the Piazza della Banca in [[Ferrano]]. It has a second branch in Ferrano, Porta Nord, and a branch in the mining village of Serravona.

parties.name: Chamber of Commerce (XU)
parties.what: Certifies the origin of the exported goods and issues ATA carnets.
parties.how: A chamber of commerce certifies that goods come from where the exporter says. UBL certificate-of-origin and goods-item-passport documents carry the application, the endorsements and the goods in a form customs on the other side can read and verify.

wiki.short: Chamber of commerce of Ferrano, Urvania
wiki.lead: The **Ferrano Chamber of Commerce** is the chamber of commerce of [[Ferrano]], [[Urvania]], on the Piazza del Mercato. It certifies the origin of goods that Urvanian firms export and issues ATA carnets for goods that go abroad for a while.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: The chamber works through two offices, one for certificates and one for carnets. Its certificates of origin state the preferential origin that goods need to cross the Accord's borders free of duty, such as the benches of [[Valdara Industries]] for [[Lumeway Distribution]]. As the issuer of a carnet it also guarantees it, while the chamber of the country visited guarantees it there. When Valdara showed two benches at the trade fair of the [[Selanu Chamber of Commerce]], the chamber issued their carnet and later answered the island's chamber with the stamped counterfoils and Urvania's record of the re-import.

parties.name: Customs (XU)
parties.what: Urvania's customs, at the land border crossing: clears the country's exports and imports, the gas that arrives by pipeline among them, and receives the declarations of goods in transit.
parties.how: Customs needs to know what crosses the border, for whom and how. UBL customs declarations reuse the parties, goods and transport details already present in the commercial and transport documents, so the declarant does not have to collect them again.

wiki.short: Urvania's customs service, at the land border crossing
wiki.lead: The **Customs Administration of Urvania** is the customs service of [[Urvania]], a public body with its border office at Valico Euridice, the road crossing into [[Bayvarra]]. It clears the country's exports and imports, the gas that arrives by pipeline among them, and supervises goods in transit.

sections.title: The border office
sections.text: The office stands on Strada del Confine at Valico Euridice (Urvanian *Menbaz*), facing Bayvarra's post at Euridice Crossing. Both take their name from Forte Euridice, 8 km down the road. The office works around the clock, with export, import and transit offices.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: Goods of Accord origin cross free of duty on proof of origin; on imports Urvania levies its value added tax of 20 % on the value with freight and insurance to the border, which a business deducts again. The office clears the exports of [[Valdara Industries]] and [[Rinova Recovery]], and each month the gas that [[Montebrio Power]] and [[Ferrano Energy]] buy from [[Kelpstone Gas]]. It enters goods worked for foreign owners under inward processing, as at [[Tostara Wood Modification]], and releases them into free circulation when they are sold in Urvania. Goods for Bayvarra can travel under the Accord's common transit from the office of departure at the rail hub in [[Ferrano]].

parties.name: Identifier Issuing Agency
parties.what: Urvania's identification agency: it gives each company that numbers its products and packages under ISO/IEC 15459 a company number, under the agency's issuing agency code; the company then numbers its own items and packages under that number.
parties.how: One issuing agency code and one company number make an item or package number unique, so a catalogue line, an order line and an invoice line point to the same thing, whoever reads them.

wiki.short: Urvania's public numbering agency for companies and products
wiki.lead: The **Codana Identification Agency** is Urvania's public numbering body, seated in [[Ferrano]], [[Urvania]]. It was founded in 1999, when the country opened its trade. It gives companies a company number under which they number their own products, packages and places.

sections.title: History
sections.text: Codana was set up by the state in 1999, in the years after the [[Lumeport Trade Accord]] entered into force, when Urvania opened its economy and a wave of companies and bodies was set up to serve cross-border trade. Its earliest members include [[Valdara Industries]], registered in November 1999, and [[Montebrio Power]], registered in December 1999.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: Codana is an issuing agency under ISO/IEC 15459, with the issuing agency code KXU, and keeps the organisation register behind the ISO/IEC 6523 code 0990. It gives each company a five-digit number, in order of registration; the company prefix is KXU followed by that number. Codana hands out no item numbers: each company numbers its own items, lots, pallets and places under its prefix, and Codana's rule book keeps every identifier to 20 characters or fewer. Codana registers any company that asks, foreign ones too: [[Rivermouth Packaging]] and [[Kelpstone Gas]] of [[Bayvarra]] are members because their customers in Urvania use the system.

sections.title: Members
sections.text: Its members include [[Valdara Industries]], [[Montebrio Power]], [[Serravona Mining]], [[Castrano Logistics]], [[Rinova Recovery]], [[Rivermouth Packaging]], [[Ferrano Grid]] and [[Kelpstone Gas]]. It is Urvania's counterpart to GS1 Bayvarra, the association that licenses GS1 company prefixes in [[Bayvarra]] and on [[Lisavu]].

parties.name: Customs (XB)
parties.what: Bayvarra's customs and border service, at the land border crossing, the seaport and the airport of Lumeport: clears imports and exports.
parties.how: Customs checks goods arriving and leaving over the land border, through the seaport and through the airport. UBL import, export and transit declarations carry the same consignment and goods data as the declaration on the other side of the border, which makes it possible to compare them.

identity.name: Customs and Border Service of Bayvarra

wiki.short: Customs and border service of Bayvarra
wiki.lead: The **Customs and Border Service of Bayvarra** is [[Bayvarra]]'s federal customs and border authority. It clears imports and exports at the land border crossing with [[Urvania]], at the seaport and at the airport of [[Lumeport]].

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: Its border office stands at Euridice Crossing in Upland State, facing the Urvanian customs post of Valico Euridice across the road; it is open around the clock. It also has offices at the seaport and the airport of [[Lumeport]], and an inland office at [[Marrowdale]], where goods arriving by rail under the Accord's common transit are declared. Goods of Accord origin enter free of duty on proof of origin. Bayvarra values imports as they left the exporting country, without freight, and charges nothing further at the border, because its sales tax falls once at the final retail sale.

sections.title: Organisation
sections.text: As a public body set up by law, the service is entered in Bayvarra's federal list of public bodies, not in the business register. It gives each trader a trader number built from the trader's number in its register.

parties.name: Distributor
parties.what: Buys finished goods from Valdara Industries, stocks them in its distribution centre in Marrowdale, publishes the catalogue and sells to Brightmarket Stores at home and to Velumi Trading on the island.
parties.how: The distributor publishes the catalogue its customers order from, buys from manufacturers and sells at home and overseas. UBL links all of it: catalogue items appear unchanged in orders, orders are referenced by despatch advices and invoices, and receipt advices confirm what actually arrived.

siding.name: Rail siding of the distribution centre, Marrowdale

goodsin.name: Distribution centre, goods-in
goodsin.description: Goods-in, dock 4 of the distribution centre, entered by gate 3 of Marrowdale Business Park

wiki.short: Bayvarran wholesale distributor in Marrowdale
wiki.lead: **Lumeway Distribution** is a wholesale distributor in [[Marrowdale]], [[Bayvarra]], founded in {founded_year}. It is the distributor of [[Valdara Industries]] for Bayvarra and [[Lisavu]] and employs about {employees} people.

sections.title: History
sections.text: When the [[Lumeport Trade Accord]] entered into force in 1996, Lumeway became Valdara's distributor under a distribution agreement, which is why Valdara's benches reach the island through [[Lumeport]]. The agreement reserves public tenders to Valdara itself.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: Lumeway buys the Serra park bench and its spare side frames from Valdara, stocks them in its distribution centre at Marrowdale Business Park and publishes a catalogue for its customers. Goods arrive by truck from [[Ferrano]], with [[Trasvia Haulage]], and by container train on the distribution centre's own rail siding. Its goods-in takes deliveries in the morning only, in slots booked a week ahead, and its customs desk clears its imports on weekdays.

sections.title: Trade
sections.text: It sells at home to [[Brightmarket Stores]] and on the island to [[Velumi Trading]], to the island at prices that include sea freight and insurance, which it buys through [[Bayforth Forwarding]]. It sells its receivables to [[Harbourline Factoring]], so its customers pay the factor.

parties.name: Retailer
parties.what: Buys from the distributor, sells to consumers; shares forecasts and promotions.
parties.how: A retailer buys from the distributor and sells to consumers. Besides orders and invoices, UBL lets it share forecasts, promotions and sales data with its supplier, and issue a structured purchase receipt to the consumer.

garden.name: Home and garden department of the Lumeport store

card_mask.note: The store's tills print only the last four digits of a card number.

wiki.short: Department store in Lumeport, Bayvarra
wiki.lead: **Brightmarket Stores**, trading as Brightmarket, is a department store company in [[Lumeport]], [[Bayvarra]], with its store on Market Street in the Old Town. Founded in {founded_year}, it sells clothing, home and garden goods to consumers in its store and its web shop, and employs about {employees} people.

sections.title: History
sections.text: Around 1981 Brightmarket and other retailers wanted bar codes at the till, and so began the article numbering association that is now GS1 Bayvarra. Brightmarket still numbers its own-label goods and its places from its GS1 company prefix.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: The store buys from [[Lumeway Distribution]], among other things the park bench Serra 180 of [[Valdara Industries]], and shares its forecasts, promotions and stock levels with it. It sells the shirts of the [[Lumeport Textile Mill]] under the mill's own brand, Lumeport. In 2026 it renovated the home and garden department of its Lumeport store, which reopened on Monday 11 May with two weeks at 10 % off. The store's van delivers furniture to customers' homes.

sections.title: Elderwick
sections.text: Elderwick is Brightmarket's own label for home and garden. Its Marrow dining bench and chair, in oak or in ash, are made to the store's specification by [[Brackenmere Furniture]] in [[Marrowdale]]; the maker's name is on no label. The store sells the bench at 549 lume and the chair at 199, gives a care kit with each bench, and offers a set of a bench and two chairs.

parties.name: Consumer
parties.what: A private person in Lumeport: buys in the department store and from its web shop, gets purchase receipts, and gets the water company's statements and bills.
parties.how: A consumer rarely deals with UBL directly, but a structured purchase receipt means the receipt can be stored, searched or used for a warranty claim without a paper slip.

parties.name: Contracting Authority
parties.what: A public body that buys under procurement law: publishes notices, receives and evaluates tenders.
parties.how: A contracting authority has to buy in a transparent and comparable way. UBL tendering documents take it from the prior information notice to the contract award, so tenders arrive in a structured form that can be checked and evaluated consistently.

identity.name: Lumeport Public Works Department
identity.tax_exemption: Buys free of the state sales tax

cost_centre.name: Parks and green spaces: parks renewal programme 2026

identity.address_desks_note: The address's department, attention and in-house mail lines are the procurement office's: they go with the roles it answers for, and are left out where another office of the department is addressed.

wiki.short: Public works department of the city of Lumeport
wiki.lead: The **Lumeport Public Works Department** is the public works department of the city of [[Lumeport]], [[Bayvarra]], on Civic Square in the Government Hill quarter. It buys goods, works and services for the city under procurement law.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: Its procurement office publishes the city's notices through the [[Bayvarra Information Service]] and receives and evaluates tenders. Under its parks renewal programme it holds a framework contract with [[Valdara Industries]] for park benches for the city's parks, with their installation by [[Saltmere Engineering]] as a second lot; it pays Valdara in lume, 30 days after each accepted release. It runs a design contest for the bench of Lumeport's harbour promenade, and buys office furniture with installation from [[Brackenmere Furniture]] for the fit-out of its planning office. Its parks depot receives the goods.

sections.title: Taxes
sections.text: As a public body it buys free of Coastal State's sales tax. It withholds 10 % of the price of a service bought from a business not established in Bayvarra and pays it to the state.

parties.name: Consortium Partner
parties.what: An engineering firm founded in 1994 in Saltmere, the east-coast village it is named after, when Bayvarra's mobile networks were built; it later moved to Marrowdale, on the road and rail to Urvania. It designs telecom mast sites and obtains their permits (a registered architect, Edda Corwin, is on its staff), and installs back-up power and safety equipment at masts across Bayvarra, dangerous goods included, with crews and anchoring gear for ground foundations. It installs and anchors the park benches as Valdara's subcontractor in the public tender, and in the design contest it teams with Brackenmere Furniture for the structure and the anchoring.
parties.how: A subcontractor or a member of a group of tenderers is named with its own role. UBL tenders and qualification documents name each member and its qualifications separately, so the authority can see who contributes what and check each one in the register.
