wiki.short: Bayvarran engineering firm for telecom mast sites
wiki.lead: **Saltmere Engineering** is an engineering firm in [[Marrowdale]], [[Bayvarra]], founded in {founded_year}. It designs telecom mast sites, obtains their permits and installs back-up power and safety equipment, and employs about {employees} people.

sections.title: History
sections.text: The firm was founded in 1994 in Saltmere, the east-coast town it is named after, when Bayvarra's mobile networks were built. It later moved to Marrowdale, on the road and rail to [[Urvania]].

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: Saltmere designs mast sites with a registered architect on its staff and installs back-up batteries, smoke detectors and other safety equipment at masts across Bayvarra, dangerous goods included; a duty engineer answers its dangerous goods emergency line around the clock. It also sells such equipment abroad: [[Selanu Telecom]] buys battery modules, smoke detectors and coating stripper from it for a mast on the island. Its crews and anchoring gear for ground foundations also suit other work: it installs and anchors park benches in [[Lumeport]] as the subcontractor of [[Valdara Industries]] for the [[Lumeport Public Works Department]].

sections.title: Design contest
sections.text: For the bench of Lumeport's harbour promenade Saltmere teamed with [[Brackenmere Furniture]], which took the design lead while Saltmere did the structure and the anchoring. The jury gave the team the first prize, ahead of Valdara.

parties.name: Review Body
parties.what: Independent body that handles appeals in public procurement.
parties.how: A review body handles appeals against procurement decisions. The tendering documents name it, with the deadlines for an appeal, so every tenderer knows where and when to go.

wiki.short: Bayvarra's independent body for public procurement appeals
wiki.lead: The **Procurement Review Board of Bayvarra** is an independent public body in [[Lumeport]], [[Bayvarra]], that hears appeals in public procurement.

sections.title: History
sections.text: The board was set up under the Trade Accord's procurement protocol of 1999, which opened the members' public tenders to suppliers from the partners and asked each member for an independent body to hear appeals.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: A tenderer or a candidate who disputes a decision of a contracting authority appeals to the board. Contracting authorities name it as the place for appeals, as the [[Lumeport Public Works Department]] does in its tender for the city's park benches and in its design contest for the harbour promenade bench. A candidate excluded from a contest is told how to appeal to it.

sections.title: Seat
sections.text: The board has its registry at Justice Row 20 on Government Hill, in a building of its own, apart from the government quarter where the contracting authorities have their offices: its independence from the authorities whose awards it reviews. The registry is open on weekdays from 08:00 to 17:00.

parties.name: Government Information Service
parties.what: Publishes procurement notices and keeps the business registry.
parties.how: A government information service publishes procurement notices and keeps the business registry. UBL notices reach it in one structured format, and business information documents let it share registry data that tenderers can reuse as evidence.

wiki.short: Bayvarra's federal publication service and business registry
wiki.lead: The **Bayvarra Information Service** is a federal public body in [[Lumeport]], [[Bayvarra]]. It publishes the notices of public procurement and keeps the country's business registry and its list of public bodies.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: Contracting authorities publish their procurement notices through the service: prior information, calls for competition, design contests, corrections and award results. [[Lumeport Public Works Department]] publishes its tenders for park benches and its design contest for the harbour promenade bench this way. As the business registry, the service keeps the entries of Bayvarra's companies and issues extracts of them, which authorities use to check tenderers such as [[Brackenmere Furniture]] and [[Saltmere Engineering]]; it reissues an extract when a company files new accounts. It also keeps the federal list of public bodies, which gives each public body in Bayvarra a ten-digit number; the [[Lumeport Trade Accord Council]] is in the list under its seat agreement.

sections.title: Seat
sections.text: Its offices are at Civic Square 27, in the government quarter on Government Hill: one building in one style, its wings round a court that opens on the square, which it shares with the [[Lumeport Public Works Department]] and the [[Federal Department of Agriculture of Bayvarra]].

parties.name: Digital Agreement Governor
parties.what: Governs the multilateral digital agreement under which the parties exchange UBL documents.
parties.how: A digital agreement sets out which documents the participants exchange and under which rules. UBL's digital agreement and digital capability documents describe that framework, and its governor keeps it up to date for all participants.

wiki.short: International body seated in Lumeport that governs the Trade Accord's electronic business documents
wiki.lead: The **Lumeport Trade Accord Council** is an international body of the three members of the [[Lumeport Trade Accord]], seated in the Old Town of [[Lumeport]], [[Bayvarra]]. It governs the Accord's multilateral agreement on the exchange of electronic business documents, which trading parties join before they trade with each other.

sections.title: History
sections.text: The agreement it governs dates from the Accord's protocol of 2014 on electronic business documents.

sections.title: Status
sections.text: The Council is entered in Bayvarra's federal list of public bodies under its seat agreement with Bayvarra, so that it can deal with Bayvarran bodies, banks and the exchange network. Like other public bodies it carries no commercial register entry. Its secretariat works from Exchange Street in the Old Town.

parties.name: Factor
parties.what: Buys the distributor's receivables and becomes the payee on its invoices.
parties.how: A factor buys the distributor's invoices and collects the payment. UBL invoices can name the factor as payee, with its account, so the buyer pays the right party without a separate letter.

wiki.short: Factoring company in Lumeport, Bayvarra
wiki.lead: **Harbourline Factoring** is a factoring company in the Old Town of [[Lumeport]], [[Bayvarra]], founded in {founded_year} to finance cross-border receivables. It employs about {employees} people.

sections.title: History
sections.text: Harbourline was founded in 1996, the year the [[Lumeport Trade Accord]] entered into force, one of the firms set up around that time to serve the new trade between the three countries.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: Harbourline buys the receivables of [[Lumeway Distribution]] and collects them: Lumeway's customers, among them [[Brightmarket Stores]] in Lumeport and [[Velumi Trading]] on [[Lisavu]], pay the factor instead of the distributor, less any credit Lumeway has granted them. It keeps its account at the [[Bank of Lumeport]] and works from Exchange Street.

parties.name: Bank (XB)
parties.what: Bayvarra's bank: holds the accounts of the distributor, its customers and the public buyer, and issues guarantees, such as the bid bond for a tender.
parties.how: A guarantor stands surety, for example for a bid bond in a tender. UBL's guarantee certificate names the guarantee, the tenderer and the contracting authority, so the authority can check it is valid.

wiki.short: Bank in Lumeport, Bayvarra
wiki.lead: **Bank of Lumeport** is a bank of [[Bayvarra]], with its head office at Exchange House on Exchange Street in the Old Town of [[Lumeport]]. Founded in {founded_year}, it holds the accounts of companies and households, makes their payments and issues guarantees, and employs about {employees} people.

sections.title: History
sections.text: The bank was founded in 1903, four years after the two colonies had joined as the federation of Bayvarra, a dominion under the British Crown: the country's settler economy is older than Urvania's state.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: Besides its main branch it has a harbour branch in Lumeport and branches in [[Marrowdale]] and in Gullhaven on the north coast. Its customers include [[Lumeway Distribution]], [[Brightmarket Stores]], [[Brackenmere Furniture]], [[Marrowdale Sawmill]], [[Lumeport Textile Mill]], [[Kelpstone Gas]], the [[Coastal State Water Company]] and the [[Lumeport Public Works Department]]. It issues tender guarantees: for [[Valdara Industries]] it gave a bank guarantee on the counter-guarantee of Valdara's own bank, [[Crevalto Bank]], and for Brackenmere it certified government bonds pledged to the buyer. Valdara also keeps a lume account with it for its contract with the [[Lumeport Public Works Department]]. Payments run over Bayvarra's clearing or, to the other two countries, over the Trade Accord's payment link. Its customers pay with the Lumecard, the debit card that Bayvarra's banks run together, and with Tressa, the credit card used across the Accord.

parties.name: Insurer
parties.what: Insures the cargo on its way overseas.
parties.how: An insurer covers the cargo while it travels. UBL transport documents can carry the insurance policy with the insurer, the policy holder and the insured value, so every party in the transport chain knows the goods are covered.

wiki.short: Marine cargo insurer in Lumeport, Bayvarra
wiki.lead: **Wavesure Cargo Insurance** is a marine insurer in [[Lumeport]], [[Bayvarra]], founded in {founded_year}. It insures cargo on its way overseas and employs about {employees} people.

sections.title: History
sections.text: Wavesure is one of the old trades of Bayvarra's port city, founded as a marine insurer decades before the Lumeport Agreement of 1974 and the [[Lumeport Trade Accord]] brought regular shipping to [[Lisavu]].

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: Its offices are on Beacon Avenue in Dockside, Lumeport's quarter of deep-water quays and warehouses. Wavesure insures goods shipped overseas, among them the park benches that [[Lumeway Distribution]] sells to [[Velumi Trading]] on the island cost, insurance and freight: [[Bayforth Forwarding]] places the cover for Lumeway, at a premium of 0.22 % of the insured value, the shipment's value plus 10 %. Its claims department handles losses and damage to the goods it covers.

parties.name: Freight Forwarder
parties.what: Books the transport, consolidates shipments and prepares the export documents; arranges cargo insurance; runs its own trucks within Bayvarra, to the port, the airport and the store.
parties.how: A freight forwarder organises transport for others. It uses UBL forwarding instructions, packing lists and manifests to combine shipments, book carriers and arrange insurance, keeping one consignment reference across all of them.

fleet.name: Container chassis truck with a clip-on generator set
fleet.genset: A diesel generator set clipped to the chassis, which powers a reefer's refrigeration on the road

wiki.short: Freight forwarder in Lumeport, Bayvarra
wiki.lead: **Bayforth Forwarding** is a freight forwarder in the Dockside quarter of [[Lumeport]], [[Bayvarra]], founded in {founded_year}. It books sea and air freight, clears exports, arranges cargo insurance and runs its own trucks within Bayvarra. It employs about {employees} people.

sections.title: History
sections.text: Bayforth was founded in 1976 to forward the island trade that grew after the Lumeport Agreement of 1974 linked [[Bayvarra]] and [[Lisavu]] by a regular shipping service.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: Bayforth books containers with [[Tidewell Ocean Lines]] and air freight with [[Kelaro Air Cargo]], lodges export declarations as customs agent and arranges cargo insurance with [[Wavesure Cargo Insurance]]. Its customers include [[Lumeway Distribution]], whose benches it ships to the island, the [[Lumeport Textile Mill]], whose cotton it brings from the port, [[Harrowmead Fruit Growers]], for whom it ships apples and pears to [[Selanu]] in reefers, and [[Quillmoor Pharma Distribution]], whose medicines it takes to the airport. Its trucks run between Marrowdale, the [[Port of Lumeport]], Lumeport airport and the shops and works of the city.

sections.title: Fleet
sections.text: The fleet has a truck with a curtain-side trailer for 33 pallets, a container chassis truck, and a second container chassis truck with a clip-on generator set, which keeps a reefer's refrigeration running on the road.

parties.name: Seaport (XB)
parties.what: Lumeport's seaport: berths, the container yard and vessel traffic for the ships to the island and beyond.
parties.how: The seaport loads the ship. UBL transport reports and status messages tell the port which containers are coming, and tell carriers and authorities what was loaded, on which vessel and when.

wiki.short: Seaport of Lumeport, Bayvarra
wiki.lead: The **Port of Lumeport** runs the seaport of [[Lumeport]], [[Bayvarra]]: its berths, its container yard and its vessel traffic. It was formed as a company in {founded_year} and employs about {employees} people.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: The port's deep-water quays lie at the inner basin behind the narrows of the estuary, linked to the railway. Its ships sail to [[Lisavu]] and beyond, among them the weekly service of [[Tidewell Ocean Lines]] to [[Selanu]].

parties.name: Ocean Carrier
parties.what: Sails the container ship to the island and issues the negotiable bill of lading.
parties.how: The ocean carrier issues the bill of lading, the document that represents the goods at sea. With UBL that document, the vessel reports and the status updates share the same consignment and container references as the forwarder's booking.

fleet.name: Tidewell Reef
fleet.description: The line's second feeder, bought second-hand in December 2025 and moved to Bayvarra's flag on 15 January 2026. Until the flag state verifies its security system, it sails with an interim International Ship Security Certificate (ISPS Code A/19.4).

wiki.short: Bayvarran shipping line between Lumeport and Selanu
wiki.lead: **Tidewell Ocean Lines** is a shipping line in [[Lumeport]], [[Bayvarra]], founded in {founded_year} to run the regular service between Bayvarra and [[Lisavu]]. It sails container feeders between Lumeport and [[Selanu]] and employs about {employees} people.

sections.title: History
sections.text: Tidewell was founded in 1974 under the Lumeport Agreement between Bayvarra and Lisavu, which called for a regular shipping service to tie the island to the mainland. In December 2025 it bought a second feeder second-hand, the *Tidewell Reef*, which came under Bayvarra's flag on 15 January 2026.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: The line sails weekly from Lumeport, out through the estuary and round the island's south-eastern cape, about 1,200 km to Selanu in about 48 hours. Its ships carry the island's imports, among them benches for [[Velumi Trading]] and chilled fruit in reefers, and bring back the island's export, the cotton bales of [[Selanu Cotton Ginnery]] for [[Lumeport Textile Mill]]. Its booking office in Lumeport's Dockside works every day from 06:00 to 22:00.

sections.title: Fleet
sections.text: Both ships are registered in Lumeport. The *Tidewell Harbour*, of 9,940 gross tonnes, takes about 1,000 TEU with a crew of 14; the *Tidewell Reef*, of 7,480 gross tonnes, about 700 TEU with a crew of 12. Until the flag state verifies its security system, the *Tidewell Reef* sails with an interim security certificate.

parties.name: Airport (XB)
parties.what: Air cargo terminal for urgent shipments overseas.
parties.how: The airport handles urgent cargo. UBL status messages let it report acceptance, loading and departure, with the air waybill reference the carrier and forwarder use.

wiki.short: Air cargo terminal at Lumeport airport, Bayvarra
wiki.lead: **Lumeport Airport Cargo Terminal** runs the air cargo terminal of Lumeport airport, [[Bayvarra]], on Airport Road outside [[Lumeport]]. Founded in {founded_year} for air freight to the island of [[Lisavu]], it handles urgent and sensitive shipments overseas and employs about {employees} people.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: The terminal works around the clock. It accepts cargo from forwarders such as [[Bayforth Forwarding]] and loads it onto the freighter of [[Kelaro Air Cargo]], which flies about 1,080 km to Selanu airport, where [[Selanu Airport Cargo]] receives it. Cargo that reaches the terminal after a flight's cut-off waits for the next flight. It handles dangerous goods, such as batteries for the island's telecom mast that may fly only on cargo aircraft, and the cold chain and radioactive packages that [[Quillmoor Pharma Distribution]] sends to [[Selanu General Hospital]].

parties.name: Seaport (XL)
parties.what: The island's seaport at Selanu: berths, the container yard and vessel traffic.
parties.how: The island's seaport discharges the ship. It receives the same UBL transport report the loading port sent, so it can plan berths and inform customs before the vessel arrives.

wiki.short: Seaport of Selanu, Lisavu
wiki.lead: The **Port of Selanu** runs the seaport of [[Selanu]], [[Lisavu]]: its berths, its container yard and its vessel traffic. It is a company owned by the state, formed in {founded_year}, and employs about {employees} people.

sections.title: History
sections.text: The port was formed as a company in 1972, ahead of the Lumeport Agreement of 1974 between [[Bayvarra]] and Lisavu, which brought a regular shipping service to the island. Its offices are on Wharf Road in Selanu.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: Selanu is the island's only port, on a sheltered bay of the east coast, out of the westerly swell. Ships from [[Lumeport]], among them the weekly service of [[Tidewell Ocean Lines]], sail about 1,200 km to reach it in about 48 hours. Selanu's pilots bring ships in by daylight only, so a ship that arrives in the dark waits under way and berths at first light. The container yard has a reefer rack where refrigerated containers wait on the port's power until they are collected, at a daily charge. The port reports discharged containers to the shippers' forwarders, among them [[Bayforth Forwarding]].

sections.title: Harbour parks and branch
sections.text: The port keeps harbour parks, for which [[Velumi Trading]] imports park benches of [[Valdara Industries]] and their spare frames. Its branch [[Selanu Airport Cargo]] runs the cargo terminal at the airport on the plain north of the town.

parties.name: Airport (XL)
parties.what: The island's airport, where the air cargo arrives.
parties.how: The island's airport receives the air cargo and reports its arrival to the carrier and the consignee in UBL status messages.

identity.name: Selanu Airport Cargo
identity.city_why: The locality the airport lies in: the airfield is on the plain north of Selanu, within Lintwell, and bears the name of the capital it serves, as airports often do that lie in a neighbouring place.

wiki.short: Air cargo handler at Selanu airport, Lisavu
wiki.lead: **Selanu Airport Cargo** handles the air cargo at [[Lisavu]]'s airport, on the plain about 10 km north of [[Selanu]], within the locality of {town}. It was founded in {founded_year} and employs about {employees} people.

sections.title: History
sections.text: The company began in 1989 as a branch of the [[Port of Selanu]]. The airfield lies in Lintwell but bears the name of the capital it serves.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: Its import desk is open around the clock. It receives the freighter flights of [[Kelaro Air Cargo]] from [[Lumeport]] and holds the cargo until it is cleared and collected: spare parts for park benches, sample benches for the trade fair of the [[Selanu Chamber of Commerce]], batteries for the mast of [[Selanu Telecom]], and medicines in temperature-controlled containers for [[Selanu General Hospital]], whose temperature readings it records on arrival. Most of the cargo is collected by [[Nalevi Warehousing]].

parties.name: Air Carrier
parties.what: The island's airline; flies urgent cargo, dangerous goods for cargo aircraft only included, with its ATR 72-600F freighter between Lumeport and Selanu.
parties.how: The air carrier flies urgent shipments. A UBL air waybill names the flight, its airports and times, the unit load devices and their positions on board, so the shipper, the terminals and the consignee read the carriage from one document.

fleet.name: ATR 72-600F freighter of Kelaro Air Cargo
fleet.description: An ATR 72-600F, the new-built freighter of the ATR 72-600 series (IATA aircraft type code ATF, ICAO type designator AT72): seven LD3 positions on the main deck (one of them for the active temperature-controlled RKN container), about 9,200 kg payload and 75 m³, a large cargo door of 2.94 × 1.80 m. A freighter, so it can carry the lithium batteries that are for cargo aircraft only.

capacity.source: ATR 72-600F fact sheet (atr-aircraft.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/ATR_Fiche72-600F-3.pdf): 7 LD3 or 5 pallets 88 × 108 in or 9 pallets 88 × 62 in, plus aft bulk cargo in all configurations; large cargo door 2.94 × 1.8 m; max gross volume 75.0 m³; max structural payload 9,200 kg. The seven LD3 positions are numbered from the front.

AKE.name: LD3 container (AKE)
AKE.source: typical values of an aluminium AKE: tare about 82 kg, maximum gross 1,588 kg (3,500 lb), internal volume about 4.3 m³ (manufacturers' and airlines' data sheets; they vary by make)

RKN.name: active temperature-controlled LD3 container (RKN)
RKN.source: Envirotainer RKN e1 technical specification: tare 635 kg, maximum gross 1,588 kg, maximum net 953 kg, internal volume 2.3 m³

wiki.short: Lisavu's airline, flying cargo between Lumeport and Selanu
wiki.lead: **Kelaro Air Cargo** is the airline of [[Lisavu]], founded in {founded_year}, with its office on Airfield Road in Lintwell. It flies cargo with an ATR 72-600F freighter between [[Lumeport]] and [[Selanu]] and employs about {employees} people.

sections.title: History
sections.text: Kelaro was founded in 1987 as the island's airline; the freighter came later.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: The freighter flies the route twice a day: KXL207 leaves Lumeport at 07:00 and KXL209 at 15:00. The flight takes about 2½ hours over about 1,080 km; the timetable allows 2 h 45 eastbound and 3 h 00 westbound. As a freighter it can carry dangerous goods that are for cargo aircraft only, such as lithium batteries, and it carries medicines for [[Selanu General Hospital]] in an active temperature-controlled container. Its cargo sales and operations work every day.

sections.title: Fleet
sections.text: The ATR 72-600F, registered QL-KXA, has seven LD3 positions on its main deck, an aft bulk compartment, a large cargo door of 2.94 × 1.80 m and about 9,200 kg of payload in 75 m³.

parties.name: Customs (XL)
parties.what: The island's customs, at the port and the airport of Selanu: clears imports and the island's exports, its cotton among them, and receives the ship's manifest before the ship arrives.
parties.how: Customs on the island receives declarations that reuse the data of the other side and of the transport documents, which speeds up clearance at the port and the airport.

wiki.short: Customs service of Lisavu, at Selanu
wiki.lead: The **Island Customs Service** is the customs service of [[Lisavu]], a public body at the port and the airport of [[Selanu]]. It clears the island's imports and exports, collects the import consumption tax, and learns what a ship carries before it arrives.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: Its import office is on Wharf Road in Selanu and works around the clock. The island has no general sales tax: customs collects an import consumption tax of 10 % on the landed value of every import, food included, and a customs duty on goods from outside the [[Lumeport Trade Accord]]. Since the Accord came into force in 1996 the island charges no duty on its partners' goods. Medicines supplied to the public hospital are free of the tax. Its export office clears the island's cotton bales, which leave through the [[Port of Selanu]].

sections.title: Traders and carnets
sections.text: Importers often declare through the licensed customs broker [[Tevaro Customs Brokers]], and a wholesaler may declare fresh food while the ship is still at sea so that it is released on discharge. Goods shown at the [[Selanu Chamber of Commerce]]'s trade fair can enter under an ATA carnet without the island's tax, provided they leave again by the carnet's time limit.

parties.name: Customs Declarant / Broker
parties.what: Licensed agent that files the import declaration for the buyer; also acts as tax representative.
parties.how: A customs declarant files declarations for importers and can act as their tax representative. UBL gives it the commercial, transport and customs data in one vocabulary, so it can assemble the declaration from documents it already receives.

wiki.short: Licensed customs broker in Selanu, Lisavu
wiki.lead: **Tevaro Customs Brokers** is a licensed customs broker in [[Selanu]], [[Lisavu]], founded in {founded_year}. It lodges import declarations for the island's buyers and acts as tax representative. It employs about {employees} people.

sections.title: History
sections.text: Tevaro was founded in 1975, the year after the Lumeport Agreement, to lodge the import declarations for the new regular shipping service between [[Lumeport]] and the island. It is one of the brokers and trades the agreement called into being in Selanu.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: Its office is on Wharf Road by the port. Tevaro clears goods that arrive at the [[Port of Selanu]] for importers such as [[Velumi Trading]], which brings in park benches from [[Lumeway Distribution]]. At the airport it declares the medicines that [[Selanu General Hospital]] receives by air from [[Quillmoor Pharma Distribution]], as the hospital's direct representative, in the hospital's name. Its declarations go to the [[Island Customs Service]], which collects the island's import consumption tax.

parties.name: Buyer's Warehouse (3PL)
parties.what: Receives the goods for the buyer and confirms what arrived; collects containers and cargo at the island's port and airport with its own truck.
parties.how: The buyer's warehouse receives the goods. Its UBL receipt advice confirms what arrived, per line and per package, which lets the buyer approve the invoice for exactly what was delivered.

wiki.short: Warehousing and haulage company in Selanu, Lisavu
wiki.lead: **Nalevi Warehousing** is a warehousing company on Lagoon Road in [[Selanu]], [[Lisavu]], founded in {founded_year}. It receives and stores imported goods for island businesses and collects containers and cargo at the island's port and airport with its own truck. It employs about {employees} people.

sections.title: History
sections.text: Nalevi was founded in 1998, in the wave of companies set up to serve the cross-border trade after the [[Lumeport Trade Accord]] entered into force, to warehouse the island's imports.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: Nalevi receives goods for [[Velumi Trading]] and confirms what arrived. Its container truck collects containers at the [[Port of Selanu]] and air cargo at [[Selanu Airport Cargo]], and carries for others on the island: the bales of [[Selanu Cotton Ginnery]] to the port, batteries to the mast site of [[Selanu Telecom]] on Mast Hill, reefers of fruit to the cold store of [[Hafefo Fresh Produce]], and sample benches between the airport and the trade fair of the [[Selanu Chamber of Commerce]]. Its goods-inwards desk is open Monday to Saturday.

parties.name: Commercial Buyer
parties.what: Needs the goods: orders from the distributor overseas and pays the invoice. Sells garden and park furniture to island customers from its shop in Selanu.
parties.how: The commercial buyer orders overseas and pays across borders. UBL lets it order from the distributor's catalogue, follow the goods through despatch and transport, match the invoice to the order and the receipt, and send a remittance advice with its payment.

card_mask.note: Velumi Trading's shop till prints the first six and the last four digits of a card number.

wiki.short: Importer and shop for garden and park furniture in Selanu
wiki.lead: **Velumi Trading** is an importer of garden and park furniture with a shop on Reef Street in [[Selanu]], [[Lisavu]], founded in {founded_year}. It employs about {employees} people.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: Velumi buys from [[Lumeway Distribution]] in [[Bayvarra]] and sells to customers on the island, from its shop and for larger projects. Its first order by sea was 104 Serra park benches by the pallet, most of them for the harbour parks of the [[Port of Selanu]], with spare side frames; as a new customer it paid a deposit and the balance to [[Harbourline Factoring]]. When it needed more frames at short notice it had them flown in by [[Kelaro Air Cargo]]. In its shop it sells the Serra bench at 375 coral. The shop is open Monday to Saturday.

parties.name: Bank (XL)
parties.what: The island's bank in Selanu: holds the accounts of the island's buyers, producers, carriers and brokers, and makes and receives their payments.
parties.how: The buyer's bank sends the payment abroad. The payment reference and payee account come straight from the UBL invoice, so the payment arrives with the information the seller's bank needs to match it.

wiki.short: Bank in Selanu, Lisavu
wiki.lead: **Bank of Selanu** is the bank of [[Lisavu]], at Reef House on Reef Street in [[Selanu]]. Founded in {founded_year} by the island's own leaders, it holds the accounts of the island's buyers, producers, carriers and brokers and makes and receives their payments; it employs about {employees} people.

sections.title: History
sections.text: The Lisavan rulers founded the bank in 1878 together with the cotton estates and the merchants of [[Selanu]], to finance the crop and the island's trade overseas: they meant to handle that trade themselves. It kept its place when the island came under British protection in 1884, and it has been the island's own bank ever since, through full self-government in 1962 and the Lumeport Agreement with [[Bayvarra]] in 1974, which tied the coral to the lume.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: It has a main branch and a market branch in Selanu. Its customers include [[Velumi Trading]], [[Selanu Cotton Ginnery]], [[Lisavu Cotton Farm]], [[Selanu Telecom]], [[Tevaro Customs Brokers]], [[Nalevi Warehousing]] and [[Hafefo Fresh Produce]]. The island's clearing, Coral net, settles tokenised deposits on the bank's ledger. Payments to and from the mainland run over the Trade Accord's payment link; when an island customer pays in lume, the bank changes its coral at the fixed parity. One of the payments that brings money to the island is the [[Lumeport Textile Mill]]'s payment for the ginnery's cotton. The island's banks run the Coralcard, the debit card in coral.

parties.name: Chamber of Commerce (XL)
parties.what: Guarantees ATA carnets on the import side.
parties.how: The chamber of commerce on the island guarantees goods-item passports for goods that enter temporarily, so customs can accept them without duties.

wiki.short: Chamber of commerce of Lisavu, in Selanu
wiki.lead: The **Selanu Chamber of Commerce** is the chamber of commerce of [[Lisavu]], seated in [[Selanu]]. It is a public body that guarantees ATA carnets on the island, classes the island's cotton and holds a trade fair.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: As the island's guarantor of ATA carnets, the chamber answers for goods that enter Lisavu for a while and leave again, such as samples for a fair. When the proof that such goods left is missing after their time limit, it asks the chamber that issued the carnet for it, as it asked the [[Ferrano Chamber of Commerce]] for two sample benches of [[Valdara Industries]]. The chamber also classes the cotton lint of [[Selanu Cotton Ginnery]], and its cotton fund is fed by a levy of 1 % that farms collect on their seed cotton. In early June it holds a trade fair in Selanu.

sections.title: Seat
sections.text: Its offices are on Reef Street in Selanu, with a carnet office and a certificates office.

parties.name: Maritime Administration
parties.what: The island's flag state administration; issues ship security certificates.
parties.how: The island's maritime administration issues ship security certificates. UBL transport reports to the port carry the certificate and its issuer, so the port can check them before the ship arrives.

wiki.short: Flag state administration of Lisavu
wiki.lead: The **Maritime Administration of Lisavu** is the flag state administration of [[Lisavu]], on Wharf Road in [[Selanu]]. It keeps the island's register of ships and issues ship security certificates.

sections.title: Organisation
sections.text: It is a public body of the island, set up by law and entered in the government list of public bodies of Lisavu, which the Government Secretariat keeps. Its ship registry is open on weekdays.

parties.name: Department of Agriculture (XL)
parties.what: The island's Department of Agriculture: its Plant Protection Service is Lisavu's plant protection organisation under the IPPC and issues the phytosanitary certificates of plants and plant products leaving the island; it also keeps the farm register.
parties.how: A plant protection organisation inspects a consignment before export and certifies it free of the pests the importing country names. UBL's goods certificate carries the inspection, its findings and the issuing authority, so the importing country's inspectors and customs can check it before the goods arrive.

wiki.short: Lisavu's department of agriculture and plant protection
wiki.lead: The **Department of Agriculture of Lisavu** is the island's government department for agriculture, on Reef Street in [[Selanu]]. Its Plant Protection Service is [[Lisavu]]'s plant protection organisation, and the department keeps the island's farm register.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: The Plant Protection Service issues the phytosanitary certificates of plants and plant products that leave the island, such as the cotton lint that [[Selanu Cotton Ginnery]] ships to [[Lumeport Textile Mill]], certifying it free of pests. The farm register records the island's growers, such as [[Lisavu Cotton Farm]]; a grower's registration is renewed each season, so each entry carries an expiry date.

parties.name: Energy Retailer
parties.what: Sells electricity and gas to Urvania's homes and businesses: buys electricity from the power station and gas from the gas producer, pays the grid operator for the networks, and bills the customers.
parties.how: In an unbundled market the retailer bills, but the grid operator owns and reads the meters. UBL keeps the two apart: the grid operator's Utility Statement carries the readings to the retailer, and the retailer's Invoice and Utility Statement carry them on to the customer.

wiki.short: Urvania's electricity and gas supplier
wiki.lead: **Ferrano Energy** supplies electricity and gas to the homes and businesses of [[Urvania]], from its head office on Corso della Repubblica in [[Ferrano]]. Founded in {founded_year}, it buys the energy, pays the grid for its networks and bills its customers; it employs about {employees} people.

sections.title: History
sections.text: The British administration set up Ferrano Energy in 1949, after the war, to bring electricity to the valley. At independence in 1962 it passed to the new state and became one of the pillars of Urvania's protected economy, beside state mining and the country's own manufacturers. When Urvania opened its economy in the early 1990s, the state sold a minority of the shares on the Ferrano Stock Exchange and kept the majority. The Trade Accord's energy protocol of 2007 asked for networks to be run apart from supply, and Urvania chose the full split: Ferrano Energy's networks became [[Ferrano Grid]] that year. Until 2011 Ferrano Energy sold only electricity; when [[Kelpstone Gas]] began producing and the pipeline brought gas to Urvania, it took up gas as a second business.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: Supply to end customers stays national under the Accord, and Ferrano Energy is Urvania's supplier. It buys electricity from [[Montebrio Power]] and other power stations, and gas from Kelpstone Gas, which it imports itself across the border. Ferrano Grid carries the energy and reads the meters, and Ferrano Energy collects the grid's network charges with its own bill: of its tariff of 27.3 ferra a kilowatt hour, 21.1 is for the energy and 6.2 for the network. A business is billed every month on its meter reading; a household pays a twelfth of the year's estimate each month by direct debit, and the meters are read once a year at the end of March. Its customers include [[Valdara Industries]].

parties.name: Water Utility
parties.what: Supplies drinking water in Coastal State, to shops and households, and runs Lumeport's district heating, whose peak boilers burn propane bought from Kelpstone Gas in winter.
parties.how: Water is billed on metered consumption. With UBL the Utility Statement carries the meter readings and the Invoice the amount; the tax exemption for water is stated explicitly, and a Reminder follows the same structure when a household pays late.

wiki.short: Water utility of Coastal State and Lumeport's district heating
wiki.lead: The **Coastal State Water Company** supplies drinking water in Coastal State, [[Bayvarra]], to shops and households, and runs the district heating of [[Lumeport]]. It is a state-owned utility, founded in {founded_year}, and employs about {employees} people.

sections.title: History
sections.text: The company is one of Bayvarra's old public services, founded in 1954. Under the [[Lumeport Trade Accord]] the supply of water to end customers stays a national matter: each country keeps its own utilities, and none supplies customers in another.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: The company's water works stand in Westside, on the estuary shore west of Lumeport's centre, and its head office on Reservoir Road. It bills businesses such as [[Brightmarket Stores]] every month on their meter readings; households pay a twelfth of the year's estimate each month by direct debit, and the meters are read once a year, at the end of March. With its water bill it collects the city of Lumeport's sewage levy on the city's behalf. A household on the heating network has one annual account for water, the levy and heat, with a correction when the return water comes back too warm.

sections.title: District heating
sections.text: The peak boilers of the district heating burn propane in winter. The company buys it from [[Kelpstone Gas]], whose tankers of [[Gullhaven Tank Haulage]] drive about 515 km from the gas plant at Gullhaven and pump it into the storage at the heating plant on Reservoir Road. Its greenhouse-gas report asks its suppliers' carriers for the emissions of the whole round trip.

parties.name: Telecom Utility
parties.what: The island's telephone and data provider.
parties.how: Telecom bills list calls, data and subscriptions per line. The UBL Utility Statement has a telecommunications structure of its own, so a business customer can allocate the costs of each line without retyping a paper bill.

wiki.short: Telephone and data provider of Lisavu
wiki.lead: **Selanu Telecom** is the telephone and data provider of [[Lisavu]], on Mast Hill Road in [[Selanu]]. It became a company in {founded_year} and employs about {employees} people.

sections.title: History
sections.text: Selanu Telecom was the island's telephone department until 1993, when it was turned into a company. It is owned by the state and entered in the business register like any company.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: It supplies telephone lines, data lines and mobile data to the island's customers and bills its business customers every month for its own service. Its customers' mobile data is also carried on partner networks abroad, which it charges per gigabyte, as the [[Lumeport Trade Accord]] has no rule on roaming. Under the Accord the telephone service to end customers stays national, so Selanu Telecom is the island's only provider. Its network stores supply the mast on Mast Hill, for which it buys back-up batteries and other equipment from [[Saltmere Engineering]] in [[Bayvarra]].

parties.name: Sawmill
parties.what: Fells timber in the forests of Upland State and saws it into planks, slats and beams at its mill on the north bank of the river; modifies ash in a thermal modification kiln of its own, and in the southern summer, when the kiln is full with its own decking and cladding, has the bench slats modified under contract across the border; sells slats for the benches across the border and timber to the furniture maker.
parties.how: Wood is sold by dimensions and volume, in lots. UBL carries the measurements and the lot of every item in quotations, orders and despatch advices, so a buyer that orders slats to size gets exactly what it ordered and can trace each lot.

wiki.short: Sawmill and timber modifier in Marrowdale, Bayvarra
wiki.lead: **Marrowdale Sawmill** is a sawmill on the north bank of the river at [[Marrowdale]], in Upland State, [[Bayvarra]], founded in {founded_year}. It saws logs from the Upland State Forest into planks, slats and beams, modifies ash in a kiln of its own and employs about {employees} people.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: Its logs come from the Upland State Forest, a managed forest on the slope north of Marrowdale. The mill makes the slats of the Serra park bench to the drawing of [[Valdara Industries]], thermally modified ash of 1,800 × 95 × 45 mm, and sells them by the bundle of 50; once a quarter 96 bundles go across the border to Valdara's factory in [[Ferrano]]. It also sells sawn oak and ash by the cubic metre to [[Brackenmere Furniture]] in Marrowdale. Its own timber truck with a crane carries logs and loads.

sections.title: Contract modification
sections.text: From October to March, the southern summer, the mill's kiln is full with its own decking and cladding. For those months it buys kiln slots from [[Tostara Wood Modification]] near Ferrano under a season agreement: it sends its kiln-dried ash blanks across the border, the plant modifies and stores them, and the mill sells the finished slats to Valdara from that stock in [[Urvania]]. For this trade it is registered for Urvania's value added tax.

parties.name: Furniture Maker
parties.what: Makes wooden furniture from the sawmill's timber; supplies the department store and furnishes public offices, installation included.
parties.how: A supplier to a retailer shares more than orders: sales per store, stock policies and agreed exception thresholds. UBL's retail collaboration documents carry them, and a Work Report documents installation work for the customer to approve.

fleet.name: Flatbed truck with loader crane
fleet.description: A three-axle flatbed truck with a loader crane behind the cab, which lifts packs of sawn timber onto the bed at the sawmill's yard and off it at the workshop.

wiki.short: Furniture maker in Marrowdale, Bayvarra
wiki.lead: **Brackenmere Furniture** makes wooden furniture in its workshop on Joiners Row in [[Marrowdale]], [[Bayvarra]]. Founded in {founded_year}, it supplies the department store [[Brightmarket Stores]] and furnishes public offices, installation included; it employs about {employees} people.

sections.title: History
sections.text: The company takes its name from Brackenmere, one of Bayvarra's railway and coast towns. It has been in business since 2000.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: Brackenmere works the timber of [[Marrowdale Sawmill]], which it collects at the sawmill's yard with its own flatbed truck and loader crane. For Brightmarket it makes the Elderwick Marrow dining bench and chair in oak and in ash, to the store's specification and under the store's label, and delivers them in its van. Under its own name it sells an office desk, the park bench PB-2 and the furnishing of public offices with installation, as for the [[Lumeport Public Works Department]]. It tenders for public contracts and in 2026 lost the city's park bench tender to [[Valdara Industries]] after an electronic auction.

sections.title: Design
sections.text: With [[Saltmere Engineering]] it forms a design team whose references are the reading garden of Lumeport's central library and the promenade benches on Larkmouth's seafront. Led by Brackenmere's own designer, the team won the first prize in the city's design contest for the bench of the harbour promenade in [[Lumeport]].

parties.name: Textile Mill
parties.what: Spins and weaves the island's cotton into fabric and makes clothing for the department store.
parties.how: Its raw material comes from overseas on a schedule. UBL forecasts and their revisions tell the ginnery what to expect, and the bill of lading, customs documents and invoice of every shipment arrive in one structure.

wiki.short: Cotton spinning, weaving and clothing mill in Lumeport, Bayvarra
wiki.lead: **Lumeport Textile Mill** spins and weaves the cotton of [[Lisavu]] into fabric and makes clothing in [[Lumeport]], [[Bayvarra]]. It was founded in {founded_year} and employs about {employees} people.

sections.title: History
sections.text: The mill was built in 1976 to spin the island's cotton, which the Lumeport Agreement of 1974 let into Bayvarra free of duty. The Mill Quarter of Lumeport grew up around it.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: The mill buys its lint from [[Selanu Cotton Ginnery]] on the island. Before each harvest it tells the ginnery how many bales it expects to buy; it then orders the bales free on board at Selanu, has [[Bayforth Forwarding]] book the sea freight, and clears them itself on arrival in Lumeport. It makes shirts under its own brand, Lumeport, and sells them to [[Brightmarket Stores]], delivered to the store. Its garment bags come from [[Rivermouth Packaging]]. The mill numbers its products in the GS1 system, under its own company prefix.

parties.name: Packaging Maker
parties.what: Makes packaging from recycled plastic granulate that arrives by barge from Urvania; packs the benches and the clothing.
parties.how: Recycled raw material comes in bulk lots by river; packaging goes out in many small orders. UBL handles both with the same order, despatch and invoice structure, across the border and at home.

wiki.short: Bayvarran maker of packaging from recycled plastic
wiki.lead: **Rivermouth Packaging** is a maker of packaging from recycled plastic on Estuary Road in [[Lumeport]], [[Bayvarra]], founded in {founded_year}. It makes stretch film and garment bags and employs about {employees} people.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: Rivermouth buys recycled polyethylene granulate from [[Rinova Recovery]] in [[Ferrano]], which [[Fiumella Barges]] carries about 250 km down the river and the estuary to Rivermouth's river quay. From it Rivermouth makes stretch film for wrapping pallets, which [[Trasvia Haulage]] trucks to [[Valdara Industries]] to wrap its bench pallets, and garment bags for the shirts of the [[Lumeport Textile Mill]], which [[Bayforth Forwarding]] delivers.

sections.title: Identification
sections.text: Although it is Bayvarran, Rivermouth registered with Urvania's [[Codana Identification Agency]] in February 2006, because its main customer, Valdara, works in that system.

parties.name: Cotton Farm
parties.what: Grows cotton on the island and delivers the seed cotton to the ginnery after the harvest.
parties.how: A farm does not write invoices: the ginnery weighs and grades the cotton and bills itself on the farm's behalf. UBL's self-billed invoice and credit note are made for exactly this, and the farm receives a structured statement of what it was paid for.

address.Description: Farm track off Plantation Road at kilometre 4, past the cotton fields.

wiki.short: Cotton farm near Lintwell, Lisavu
wiki.lead: **Lisavu Cotton Farm** is a cotton farm near Lintwell on the dry north-eastern plain of [[Lisavu]], run by its owner since {founded_year}.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: The farm grows cotton on the plain where the island's rain shadow keeps the land dry and sunny, land that has grown cotton since the estates of the 1860s. After the harvest, from March to May, it delivers its seed cotton to [[Selanu Cotton Ginnery]], which weighs and grades it and settles each delivery for the farm itself.

parties.name: Cotton Ginnery
parties.what: Gins the farms' seed cotton into bales and exports them to the textile mill on the mainland: the island's export.
parties.how: The ginnery buys from many farms and sells overseas. UBL covers both sides: self-billing towards the farms, and towards the mill an export with weight statement, goods certificate, customs declaration and invoice.

wiki.short: Cotton ginnery at Bollworth, Lisavu
wiki.lead: **Selanu Cotton Ginnery** gins the island's seed cotton at Bollworth, on the dry north-eastern plain of [[Lisavu]], and exports the lint, the island's main export. It was founded in {founded_year} and employs about {employees} people.

sections.title: History
sections.text: The ginnery was founded in 1936, when cotton was already the island's old export, grown on the estates that English settlers laid out on the plain in the 1860s. It took over the ginning from the estates' own gins and buys from the estates and the island's small farms alike. Since the Lumeport Agreement of 1974 the island's cotton enters [[Bayvarra]] free of duty.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: Under a season agreement the ginnery advances each farm, such as [[Lisavu Cotton Farm]], a quarter of the value of its expected delivery in January, while the crop grows. When the farms bring their seed cotton after the harvest, from March to May, the ginnery weighs and grades it, settles each delivery for the farm itself, and gins it into compressed bales of about 227 kg. The lint is classed by the [[Selanu Chamber of Commerce]] and certified free of pests by the [[Department of Agriculture of Lisavu]].

sections.title: Trade
sections.text: Its buyer is [[Lumeport Textile Mill]], which buys the lint free on board [[Selanu]]; the bales cross to [[Lumeport]] on the ships of [[Tidewell Ocean Lines]].

parties.name: Gas Producer
parties.what: Produces natural gas from an offshore field off Bayvarra's north coast; treats it at its plant on the shore and sends it by pipeline to the power station and the grid of Urvania. The propane it separates from the field's gas at the plant is sold by road tanker to customers in Bayvarra, among them the peak boilers of Lumeport's district heating.
parties.how: Gas is sold by energy, measured at the border, and crosses it by pipeline every day. UBL carries the monthly sale as an Invoice in energy units, the export and import by fixed installation (transport mode 7) in the customs declarations, and a Reminder when the buyer pays late.

site.description: Gas treatment plant on the north coast; the platform of the offshore field lies about {km} kilometres out.

wiki.short: Natural gas producer on Bayvarra's north coast
wiki.lead: **Kelpstone Gas** produces natural gas from an offshore field off the north coast of [[Bayvarra]] and treats it at its plant at Gullhaven, a fishing village in the Northern Territory. Founded in {founded_year}, it sells the gas by pipeline to [[Urvania]] and propane by road tanker in Bayvarra, and employs about {employees} people.

sections.title: History
sections.text: The company was founded in 2011 and began producing that year, when the pipeline first brought gas to Urvania; the Trade Accord's energy protocol of 2007 had opened the wholesale trade in gas between the three countries. Because its customers are Urvanian, it registered with Urvania's [[Codana Identification Agency]] in October 2012.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: A subsea line brings the gas ashore from the production platform to the plant, which treats it to pipeline quality. The pipeline runs about 207 km across the border to [[Montebrio Power]], with a branch of about 97 km to the city gate of [[Ferrano Grid]] for the customers of [[Ferrano Energy]]; the gas is measured at a metering station on Bayvarra's side of the border. The plant also separates propane from the field's gas and sells it by the tonne, weighed on its weighbridge; [[Gullhaven Tank Haulage]] carries it by road tanker, among others to the [[Coastal State Water Company]], which burns it in winter in the peak boilers of Lumeport's district heating.

parties.name: Power Station
parties.what: A gas-fired power station near Serravona: burns gas from Bayvarra's offshore field and sells the electricity to the retail company through the grid.
parties.how: A producer sells energy in bulk, by the month, to a few buyers. UBL's Invoice carries the quantities in megawatt hours and the price per unit, and the Utility Statement of the grid operator shows what was fed in.

wiki.short: Gas-fired power station near Serravona, Urvania
wiki.lead: **Montebrio Power** runs a gas-fired power station of about 40 MW near Serravona, [[Urvania]]. It was founded in {founded_year} and employs about {employees} people. It burns gas from [[Bayvarra]]'s offshore field and sells the electricity through the grid.

sections.title: History
sections.text: The state built the station in 1974, in the years of the protected economy, below Monte Brio, the hill near Serravona that gave it its name. It burned heavy fuel oil, which came up the river by barge to Ferrano and on by rail. In 1998, as Urvania opened its economy, the state sold the company to Urvanian pension funds, which own it still. Since 2011 it has burned gas from the offshore field of [[Kelpstone Gas]], brought by pipeline across the border, under the energy protocol of the [[Lumeport Trade Accord]], which opened the wholesale trade in gas and electricity in 2007. In 1999 it was among the first members of the [[Codana Identification Agency]].

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: The gas reaches the station by a pipeline of about 207 km from Kelpstone's plant at Gullhaven, metered at a station on Bayvarra's side of the border. Montebrio declares its own import of the gas and pays for it in ferra. It is one of Urvania's several power stations; it feeds its electricity into the network of [[Ferrano Grid]] and sells it to [[Ferrano Energy]], the retail company that bills the customers. Urvania's energy market is unbundled, so production, network and retail supply are run by separate companies.

parties.name: Grid Operator
parties.what: Runs the electricity and gas networks of the Ferrano region: connects the power station and the gas pipeline, owns the meters, reads them and charges the retail company for the use of the networks.
parties.how: The grid operator measures what every customer takes, whoever sells to them. UBL's Utility Statement carries its readings to the retail company, with the corrections a gas meter needs, and its Invoice charges the network per connection.

wiki.short: Electricity and gas network operator of the Ferrano region, Urvania
wiki.lead: **Ferrano Grid** runs the electricity and gas networks of the Ferrano region of [[Urvania]], from its offices on the Via della Rete in [[Ferrano]]. It was founded in {founded_year} and employs about {employees} people.

sections.title: History
sections.text: Ferrano Grid was split off from [[Ferrano Energy]] as a company of its own in 2007, when the energy protocol of the [[Lumeport Trade Accord]] asked for networks to be run apart from supply and Urvania chose the full split. The networks are a natural monopoly, and the state holds the company directly, apart from the partly listed retail company. It was an electricity company until 2011, when [[Kelpstone Gas]] began producing and the pipeline brought gas to Urvania; it then took up gas as a second business.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: The company connects [[Montebrio Power]] and the gas pipeline from [[Bayvarra]], whose branch reaches its city gate after about 97 km. It owns the meters, reads them and corrects the gas readings. It charges [[Ferrano Energy]] for the use of its networks per kilowatt hour taken at each connection, and Ferrano Energy collects the network charges with its bills to customers: of a tariff of 27.3 ferra a kilowatt hour, 6.2 are for the network.

parties.name: Environment Agency (XU)
parties.what: Urvania's environment agency, the competent authority of its waste law: it issues the permits of waste treatment plants, registers waste carriers, and receives the producers' notifications of their waste streams, which it acknowledges with a waste-stream number, and the facilities' reports of each load received.
parties.how: A waste authority must know which waste moves, from whom and to which facility. UBL's waste notification tells it the waste stream before the movements start, and the waste movement reports each load as it is received, so the authority can follow the waste from the producer to its recovery without collecting the figures again.

wiki.short: Urvania's environment agency, the authority for waste
wiki.lead: The **Environment Agency of Urvania** is the competent authority of [[Urvania]]'s waste law, on the Via delle Acque in [[Ferrano]]. It issues the permits of waste treatment plants, registers waste carriers and keeps track of the country's waste streams.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: A producer notifies each waste stream for a year to the agency before the first load, with the waste, the planned total and number of loads, the period and the facility, and the agency acknowledges it with a waste-stream number. A domestic stream of non-hazardous waste for recovery needs no consent. The facility then reports to the agency each load it receives, with its net weight. The agency has issued the operating permit of [[Rinova Recovery]] and registered [[Trasvia Haulage]] as a waste carrier, and it receives the notification of [[Valdara Industries]] for its baled film waste.

parties.name: Rail Infrastructure Manager (XU)
parties.what: Urvania's rail infrastructure manager, a public body: it owns and maintains the country's tracks, allocates the train paths and runs the traffic control that dispatches every train on them, from the ore line to the border station. Urvania separated its rail infrastructure from the train operators, as it separated its electricity grid from supply, so Ferrano Rail Cargo runs its trains on paths it is given here.
parties.how: A transport service provider asks the manager of the network where its train is. UBL's Transport Progress Status Request goes from the carrier to the transportation network manager, and the Transport Progress Status answers with the train's position and its timetable at each point the manager controls, so the carrier can tell its customers when the goods will arrive.

wiki.short: Urvania's public rail infrastructure manager
wiki.lead: The **Rail Infrastructure Agency of Urvania** is the public body that owns and maintains [[Urvania]]'s railway tracks, allocates the train paths and dispatches every train on them. It is seated on Via della Stazione in [[Ferrano]].

sections.title: History
sections.text: Urvania set up the agency in 2004, when it separated its rail infrastructure from the train operators of the state railway, as it later separated its electricity grid from supply; the railway's freight arm became [[Ferrano Rail Cargo]], a company of its own.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: The agency's network covers the ore line from the mine siding at Fucinalta down to [[Valdara Industries]]' works at Ferrano and the line from Ferrano to the border station on the way to [[Marrowdale]]. Its traffic control works around the clock. Train operators such as [[Ferrano Rail Cargo]] run their trains on the paths it gives them, and it reports a train's position and timetable on its network to the operator, from the intermodal hub at Ferrano to the border station.

parties.name: Design Studio
parties.what: A small industrial design studio in Lumeport, founded in 2019 by two designers. It asked to take part in the design contest for the harbour promenade bench and was excluded at the selection: the certificate of the social security fund showed contributions due and unpaid, above the minor amounts the procurement act tolerates.
parties.how: A candidate that is excluded is told why. UBL's Tenderer Qualification Response carries the decision on each candidate, with the reason for an exclusion, so the candidate knows where it stands and can appeal.

wiki.short: Small industrial design studio in Lumeport, Bayvarra
wiki.lead: **Fernhollow Studio** is a small industrial design studio in [[Lumeport]], [[Bayvarra]], founded in {founded_year} by two designers. It employs about {employees} people.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: The studio works from Ropewalk Lane in Lumeport. It asked to take part in the city's design contest for the bench of its harbour promenade, held by the [[Lumeport Public Works Department]], and was excluded at the selection: the certificate of the social security fund showed contributions due and unpaid, above the minor amounts the procurement act tolerates. The first prize went to the team of [[Brackenmere Furniture]] and [[Saltmere Engineering]].

parties.name: Tank Haulier
parties.what: A road tank haulier at Gullhaven, beside the gas plant, licensed to carry dangerous goods in tanks: its tankers carry the propane Kelpstone Gas recovers at its plant to customers in the south, among them the Coastal State Water Company's peak boilers in Lumeport, and come back empty.
parties.how: A tank haulier carries one load at a time. UBL's consignment note carries the dangerous goods as they are loaded in the tank, with the orange plates, the placard, the tunnel restriction and the tank as transport equipment, so that consignor, carrier and consignee read the same data.

authorization.purpose: Carriage of dangerous goods by road in tanks

fleet.name: Tractor unit with an LPG tank semi-trailer

tank.approval: A pressure tank for liquefied flammable gases, approved for UN 1965; its plate gives 49 m³ and a maximum load of 20,500 kg.

wiki.short: Road tank haulier at Gullhaven, Bayvarra
wiki.lead: **Gullhaven Tank Haulage** is a road tank haulier at Gullhaven, the fishing village in [[Bayvarra]]'s Northern Territory, beside the gas plant of [[Kelpstone Gas]]. It was founded in {founded_year} and employs about {employees} people.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: The company holds the federal permit to carry dangerous goods by road in tanks. Its tankers carry the propane Kelpstone Gas recovers at its plant to customers in the south, among them the [[Coastal State Water Company]], which burns it in the peak boilers of [[Lumeport]]'s district heating in winter. A tanker is weighed on the plant's weighbridge empty and full, drives the day to Lumeport, about 515 km, pumps the propane into the customer's storage and returns empty the next day. Its planning desk works around the clock.

sections.title: Fleet
sections.text: Its tractor units pull pressure tank semi-trailers approved for liquefied flammable gas. One such tank holds 49 m³ and up to 20,500 kg; with about 20 t of propane the loaded vehicle weighs about 37 t, within the Accord's limit of 40 t.

parties.name: Pharmaceutical Wholesaler
parties.what: A pharmaceutical wholesaler founded in 1991 beside Lumeport airport, so that medicines that come in by air and go on by air never wait far from the runway. It buys medicines, vaccines and radiopharmaceuticals from makers abroad, keeps them in its cold rooms at 2 to 8 °C and in a freezer room, and supplies pharmacies and hospitals in the three countries of the Accord. It holds the wholesale distribution authorisation of Bayvarra's medicines regulator, which the Accord's mutual recognition makes valid in Urvania and Lisavu, and a licence to hold and transport radioactive material. Its warehouse works every day and through the night, because radiopharmaceuticals arrive and leave by the night and early flights; its own van, with a driver trained for class 7, takes radioactive packages to the airport.
parties.how: A wholesaler sells many lines to many customers and must show, for medicines, the lot and its expiry date on every delivery. UBL's despatch advice carries the lot of each line and its expiry, and the transport documents the temperatures the goods need, so the hospital can check the cold chain and the lots when it receives them.

wiki.short: Pharmaceutical wholesaler beside Lumeport airport
wiki.lead: **Quillmoor Pharma Distribution** is a pharmaceutical wholesaler beside the airport of [[Lumeport]], [[Bayvarra]], founded in {founded_year}. It supplies pharmacies and hospitals in the three countries of the [[Lumeport Trade Accord]] and employs about {employees} people.

sections.title: History
sections.text: Quillmoor was founded in 1991 beside the airport, so that medicines that come in by air and go on by air never wait far from the runway.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: It buys medicines, vaccines and radiopharmaceuticals from makers abroad, among them makers in India and the Netherlands, and keeps them in cold rooms at 2 to 8 °C and in a freezer room. It holds the wholesale distribution authorisation of Bayvarra's medicines regulator, which the Accord's mutual recognition makes valid in [[Urvania]] and [[Lisavu]], and a licence to hold and transport radioactive material. Its warehouse works every day and through the night, because radiopharmaceuticals arrive and leave on night and early flights. On the island it supplies [[Selanu General Hospital]] by air, with vaccines, insulin and technetium generators for its nuclear medicine unit.

sections.title: Fleet
sections.text: Its own closed van, with a locked and lined cargo compartment and a driver trained for radioactive material, takes radioactive packages to the airport's cargo terminal.

parties.name: Hospital (XL)
parties.what: The island's general hospital in Selanu, a public body of Lisavu's health service: wards, an operating theatre, the island's vaccination service and a small nuclear medicine unit, which makes its technetium-99m every morning from a generator replaced once a week. Its pharmacy orders medicines, vaccines and the generator from a wholesaler in Lumeport; they come by air, and the pharmacy's van fetches them from the airport.
parties.how: A hospital pharmacy buys by order and checks every delivery against the despatch advice: the lots, their expiry dates and the temperatures on the way. UBL lets it receive those facts with the goods and keep them with its stock.

fleet.description: The hospital pharmacy's van: a compartment kept at 2 to 8 °C, a freezer box and a locked, lined box for radioactive packages; its drivers are trained for class 7.

wiki.short: General hospital of Lisavu, in Selanu
wiki.lead: **Selanu General Hospital** is the general hospital of [[Lisavu]], on Reef Street in [[Selanu]], a public body of the island's health service. It has wards, an operating theatre, the island's vaccination service and a small nuclear medicine unit.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: The nuclear medicine unit makes its technetium-99m every morning from a generator that is replaced once a week. The hospital pharmacy buys medicines, vaccines and the generator from [[Quillmoor Pharma Distribution]], a wholesaler beside Lumeport airport, among them the vaccines for the island's winter influenza campaign. They come by air on the freighter of [[Kelaro Air Cargo]]; [[Tevaro Customs Brokers]] clears them for the hospital, free of duty and of the import consumption tax, and the pharmacy's van fetches them from the airport.

sections.title: Fleet
sections.text: The pharmacy's van has a compartment kept at 2 to 8 °C, a freezer box and a locked, lined box for radioactive packages; its drivers are trained to carry radioactive material.

parties.name: Fruit Packers' Cooperative
parties.what: The fruit growers of the slopes above Harrowmead, in the wetter west of Upland State, own it together: it grades, packs and cold-stores its members' apples and pears and sells them at home and overseas, the island among its markets.
parties.how: Fresh produce is sold by variety, size and lot, and must stay cold all the way. UBL carries the varieties and grower lots in the despatch advice, the reefer's settings in the forwarding instructions and the bill of lading, and the phytosanitary certificate the importing country asks for, so the buyer can trace every pallet to the orchard and check the cold chain.

packhouse.description: The loading dock of the packhouse and cold store on Orchard Road, Harrowmead

wiki.short: Fruit growers' cooperative at Harrowmead, Bayvarra
wiki.lead: **Harrowmead Fruit Growers** is a cooperative owned by the fruit growers of the slopes above Harrowmead, in the wetter west of Upland State, [[Bayvarra]]. Founded in {founded_year}, it grades, packs and cold-stores its members' apples and pears and sells them at home and overseas. It employs about {employees} people.

sections.title: Facilities
sections.text: Its packhouse and cold store stand on Orchard Road at the edge of Harrowmead, a market town of the western wheat land founded by British settlers in the 1850s; the orchards lie on the slopes above the town.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: Its members grow Gala and Granny Smith apples and Packham's Triumph pears, packed in cartons of 18 kg and graded under the [[Lumeport Trade Accord]]'s marketing standard for fresh fruit. Gala and the pears are picked in February and March and kept in its cold store; Granny Smith, the late variety, is picked in April. [[Lisavu]] is among its markets: it sells a reefer container of fruit to [[Hafefo Fresh Produce]] in [[Selanu]], carriage and insurance paid to the port, and has [[Bayforth Forwarding]] book the reefer on [[Tidewell Ocean Lines]], bring it pre-cooled to the packhouse and insure the fruit. Before loading, the Plant Health Service of the [[Federal Department of Agriculture of Bayvarra]] inspects the fruit at the packhouse for the pests the island keeps out.

parties.name: Fresh Produce Wholesaler
parties.what: Imports fruit and vegetables the island does not grow or not in the season, keeps them in its own cold store by the port and supplies the island's shops, hotels and the hospital's kitchen.
parties.how: A fresh-produce importer must know what is on its way and in what state it arrives. UBL brings it the supplier's despatch advice with the lots, the carrier's reefer data and its own receipt advice with the temperatures read at unloading, so a claim on a lot that arrived too warm rests on the documents.

wiki.short: Fresh fruit and vegetable importer in Selanu, Lisavu
wiki.lead: **Hafefo Fresh Produce** is a wholesaler of fresh fruit and vegetables on Wharf Road in [[Selanu]], [[Lisavu]], founded in {founded_year}. It imports produce the island does not grow, or not in the season, and employs about {employees} people.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: Hafefo keeps its own cold store by the port and supplies the island's shops, hotels and the kitchen of [[Selanu General Hospital]]. In the southern autumn it buys reefers of apples and pears from [[Harrowmead Fruit Growers]] in Bayvarra's Upland State, carriage and insurance paid to the [[Port of Selanu]]; they come on the weekly service of [[Tidewell Ocean Lines]]. It lodges its import declarations itself, while the ship is at sea, and [[Nalevi Warehousing]] takes the reefer from the port to the cold store. Imported food pays the island's import consumption tax like every import. Hafefo pays Harrowmead in lume from its account at [[Bank of Selanu]]. Its purchasing desk works from early morning, Monday to Saturday.

parties.name: Department of Agriculture (XB)
parties.what: Bayvarra's federal Department of Agriculture: its Plant Health Service is the country's plant protection organisation under the IPPC, which inspects plants and plant products for export and issues their phytosanitary certificates.
parties.how: A plant protection organisation inspects a consignment before export and certifies it free of the pests the importing country names. UBL's goods certificate carries the inspection, its findings and the issuing authority, so the importing country's inspectors and customs can check it before the goods arrive.

identity.name: Federal Department of Agriculture of Bayvarra

wiki.short: Bayvarra's federal department of agriculture and plant health
wiki.lead: The **Federal Department of Agriculture of Bayvarra** is [[Bayvarra]]'s federal government department for agriculture, on Civic Square on Government Hill in [[Lumeport]]. Its Plant Health Service is the country's plant protection organisation.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: The Plant Health Service inspects plants and plant products for export and issues their phytosanitary certificates. For fresh fruit bound for [[Lisavu]] it inspects the fruit at the packhouse before loading, on the exporter's application, and certifies it free of codling moth and fire blight, the two pests the island, which has neither, keeps out; the apples and pears of [[Harrowmead Fruit Growers]] for [[Hafefo Fresh Produce]] are certified so.

parties.name: Wood Modification Plant
parties.what: Thermally modifies wood in two steam kilns at Conciaro: beech, ash and poplar for Urvanian timber merchants, and under contract for sawmills across the border in their busy months; it planes, end-seals and bundles the wood, stores it for its owner and hands it to the carrier the owner names. It holds an authorisation for inward processing, so wood of a foreign owner is worked without Urvania's import tax until it is released.
parties.how: A contract processor works on goods it does not own. UBL's Order carries the processing job with the customer's own material as a sub-line, the Inventory Report the customer's goods in the plant's store and when they are ready, the Order Change the call-off, and the Invoice the processing alone, a service to a customer abroad.

wiki.short: Urvanian thermal wood modification plant at Conciaro
wiki.lead: **Tostara Wood Modification** is an independent plant that thermally modifies wood in two steam kilns at Conciaro, east of [[Ferrano]], [[Urvania]]. Founded in {founded_year}, it works for Urvanian timber merchants and, under contract, for sawmills across the border, and employs about {employees} people.

sections.title: Operations
sections.text: Its name comes from the Italian *tostare*, to roast. The plant stands on Via delle Concerie in Conciaro, the village where the town once put its tanneries, downwind. It modifies beech, ash and poplar at about 212 °C in steam, then planes, end-seals and bundles the wood, stores it for its owner in covered bays and hands it to the carrier the owner names. It holds an authorisation for inward processing, so wood of a foreign owner is worked without Urvania's import tax until the owner releases it.

sections.title: Customers
sections.text: From October to March, the southern summer, [[Marrowdale Sawmill]]'s own kiln is full with its decking and cladding, so the sawmill buys kiln slots at Tostara under a season agreement. Tostara modifies the sawmill's kiln-dried ash blanks into park-bench slats for [[Valdara Industries]] and keeps them until the sawmill calls them off for delivery to Valdara's works.

referenced.name: Maritime Administration
referenced.what: Bayvarra's flag state administration: keeps the register of Bayvarran ships and issues their international ship security certificates under the ISPS Code. Referenced only, as the issuer of the certificate of Tidewell Ocean Lines' ship.

referenced.name: Port Health Office
referenced.what: Bayvarra's port health authority at Lumeport, an office of the federal health administration, as the Maritime Administration is federal: under the International Health Regulations (2005) it inspects ships in the port and issues their ship sanitation control and exemption certificates (Annex 3) and the medicine chest certificates of Bayvarran ships. Referenced only, as the issuer of the certificates of Tidewell Ocean Lines' ships.

referenced.what: An accredited certification body in Ferrano (a private company): it audits recycling plants for the traceability and the recycled content of what they make, under a recycled-content scheme that follows EN 15343:2007, as industry schemes such as RecyClass do, and issues their recycled-content certificates; it audits Rinova Recovery's plant every year. turnover_per_person.note: Rules of thumb for a company's yearly turnover per person, in lume, by the kind of business it is in (identity.legal.business): estimates of typical ranges, meant to catch the implausible. Turnovers in ferra and coral count at the reference rates. Only companies in a commercial register are checked: public bodies have no company figures, and a farm is entered in Lisavu's farm register, not the companies register. tools/world_parties.py checks every company against its band. Shipping lines and oil and gas producers have bands of their own, because their ships and platforms make them earn far more per person than other transport or industry (owner, 2026-11-19).

abroad.name: Isotope Maker (NL)
abroad.what: A fictional maker of radiopharmaceuticals in the Netherlands, outside the world: it fills molybdenum-99 from the research reactors of Europe into technetium-99m generators and sends them, pre-calibrated to a reference time six days after delivery, to hospitals and wholesalers around the world by scheduled air cargo from Amsterdam. Quillmoor Pharma Distribution buys one generator a week for Selanu General Hospital under a standing order. Not a party of the world: it has no place on the map; its name was checked against real companies.

Quillmoor Pharma Distribution buys its vaccines and insulin for the southern winter from it. Not a party of the world: it has no place on the map; its name was checked against real companies.

numbering.note: How the world's companies number their documents (D24, D25, O75): each issuer numbers its own documents per kind of document, rising with the time of issue. A document's number follows from its issue moment and the issuer's estimated yearly volume of that kind: volume (the yearly count of its main documents) times the factor of the kind, unless volumes gives the kind its own count. Styles: range (a plain number from the business system, one range per kind, running on since the year the system started), code (the company's code, the kind, the year and a number, restarting each year), year (the year and a number), file (a public body's file reference), none (numbers nothing). Across the styles: Urvanian invoices and credit notes are numbered within the year by Urvania's rules for value added tax; an air waybill has the airline's designator, a serial and a check digit; a bill of lading the shipping line's code and a number. The code of a company is unique in the world and is used only where its style has one, and for the identifiers it gives that are not document numbers. Kept by hand; tools/examples_kit.py (numbering) applies it and tools/build_examples.py (check_numbering) checks it.
